name: Alpha Brotherhood
source:
Alpha Brotherhood is a 3D adult choice-driven visual novel about the day-to-day life of a student who investigates the naughty things university students do. 

After having his work approved by the famous Professor Culp, one of the best professors at Remingdale University, Mason moved on to start a new life as Culp's pupil. However, he wasn't expecting to find so hot men as a straight neighbor, a muscle nerd, and a naughty mentor.

[From [url=https://maledollstudio.itch.io/alpha-brotherhood]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《阿尔法兄弟会》是一部由选择驱动的3D成人视觉小说，讲述一名学生的日常生活，调查大学生的淘气行为。

在他的工作得到了雷明代尔大学最优秀的教授之一、著名的卡尔普教授的认可后，梅森作为卡尔普的学生开始了新的生活。然而，他没想到会找到如此性感的男人，一个直男邻居，一个肌肉书呆子，一个顽皮的导师。

[来自[url=https://maledollstudio.itch.io/alpha-brotherhood]Itch.io[/url]]
